headline: Kruk's 12th-inning grand slam walks off Cardinals
recap: With the bases loaded and two outs in the bottom of the 12th inning, John Kruk hit a grand slam off Cardinals reliever Matt Kinzer, giving the Phillies a 9-5 win over St. Louis. Dennis Cook led off the inning with a single, Tom Herr singled him to third, and Von Hayes walked to load the bases before Kruk's slam ended it.

Cardinals starter Joe Magrane worked 6 1/3 innings, allowing four runs (three earned) on nine hits with four walks. Phillies starter Don Carman lasted four innings, charged with four earned runs on five hits, including a home run to Ozzie Smith, with four strikeouts and three walks.

Kruk finished 3-for-6 with four RBIs and three runs scored, and Tom Herr and Dickie Thon each had three hits for the Phillies. Dennis Cook, who batted for himself as the Phillies' pitcher of record, threw three scoreless innings in relief to earn the win; Kinzer took the loss.
